Abel-Regular.ttf is an unmodified test font from Google Fonts:
https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/abel

Copyright 2011 Matthew Desmond. Distributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1;
the complete license and reserved font name are in OFL-Abel.txt.

The native HTML export test places this font in its isolated managed library so
SVG conversion can be verified without installing fonts on the host computer.
